name: Belle Campground
note: Joshua Tree NP. 18-site campground among granite boulders off Pinto Basin Rd, first-come, first-served; pit toilets, no water. RVs/trailers allowed (most sites fit 25-30 ft, largest to ~35 ft). --Claude

name: White Tank Campground
note: Joshua Tree NP. 15-site campground among granite off Pinto Basin Rd, first-come, first-served; pit toilets, no water. Small sites (combined vehicle length ~25 ft) - a 23-ft rig fits the larger sites. --Claude

name: Hidden Valley Campground
note: Joshua Tree NP. 44-site campground nestled in the boulders of the central park, first-come, first-served (very popular, fills most weekends Sept-May); pit toilets, no water. Sites take RVs to ~25 ft combined length. --Claude

name: Black Rock Campground
note: Joshua Tree NP, Black Rock Canyon at the NW corner near Yucca Valley. 99 sites with potable water, flush toilets and a dump station; reservable Oct-May and FCFS in summer. Big-rig friendly (sites to ~35 ft), no hookups. --Claude

name: Indian Cove Campground
note: Joshua Tree NP, Indian Cove on the north side off Hwy 62. ~100 sites tucked among the rocks; pit toilets, no water in camp (water at the ranger station); reservable Oct-May and FCFS in summer. Individual sites take RVs (group sites cap ~25 ft). --Claude

name: Boise Creek Campground
note: Six Rivers NF (Lower Trinity RD) campground on Hwy 299 near Willow Creek, between Boise Creek and the Trinity River (~2 mi). 18 single-family sites, no hookups, vault toilets; max trailer length 35 ft. Reservable online, some sites first-come, first-served. --Claude

name: Dillon Creek Campground
note: Six Rivers/Klamath NF campground on Hwy 96 where Dillon Creek meets the Klamath River, a popular salmon-fishing reach. 21 single-family sites, no hookups; no running water for the 2026 season. Reservable online, some sites first-come, first-served. --Claude

name: Dixie Glade Campground
note: Small Mendocino NF campground on Fouts Springs Rd ~14 mi W of Stonyford; 7 sites plus a day-use/picnic area, vault toilet, no drinking water, trailers to 30 ft, drive-in. First-come, first-served (recreation.gov scan-and-pay on site). --Claude

name: Little Stony Campground
note: Mendocino NF campground along Little Stony Creek ~10 mi SW of Stonyford; 8 sites, 11 tables, fire rings, 2 vault toilets, trailers to 24 ft, drive-in. First-come, first-served (recreation.gov scan-and-pay). --Claude

name: Howard Lake Campground
note: Small Mendocino NF campground beside little Howard Lake in the Yolla Bolly high country NE of Covelo (~3,900 ft); ~6 sites, vault toilet, no hookups, forest-road drive-in access. First-come, first-served (recreation.gov scan-and-pay). --Claude

name: Hammerhorn Lake Campground
note: Mendocino NF campground near small Hammerhorn Lake in the Yolla Bolly country NE of Covelo (~3,500 ft); ~9 sites, vault toilet, no hookups, paved loop off Indian Dick Rd (FH7), drive-in. First-come, first-served (not on recreation.gov). --Claude

name: Little Doe Campground
note: Mendocino NF campground on the ridge near Howard Lake NE of Covelo (~3,700 ft); ~13 sites, vault toilets, no drinking water, forest-road drive-in access. First-come, first-served (recreation.gov scan-and-pay). --Claude

name: Kingsley Glade Campground
note: Small Mendocino NF campground on a forest glade E of Covelo / N of Paskenta (~4,400 ft); ~6 sites, spring water, vault toilet, forest-road drive-in access. First-come, first-served (not on recreation.gov). --Claude

name: Hell Gate Campground
note: USFS Shasta-Trinity NF campground on the South Fork Trinity River off Hwy 3, south of Hayfork. Paved loop with ~17 single sites (tables/fire rings), vault toilets, no hookups; drive-in, first-come first-served. Satellite shows a paved figure-eight loop with vehicle pull-ins right above the river. --Claude

name: Big Bar Campground
note: Small USFS Shasta-Trinity NF campground on the Wild & Scenic Trinity River at Big Bar, Hwy 299. ~3-4 sites with tables/fire rings, vault toilet, no hookups; drive-in, first-come first-served. --Claude

name: Big Flat Campground
note: USFS Shasta-Trinity NF campground on the Wild & Scenic Trinity River off Hwy 299 near Junction City. ~10 sites with tables/fire rings, vault toilets, no hookups; drive-in, first-come first-served; popular river-access/rafting area. --Claude

name: Big Slide Campground
note: USFS Shasta-Trinity NF campground on the South Fork Trinity River near Hyampom (Lower South Fork Rd). ~8 primitive sites, tables/fire rings, vault toilet, no hookups; drive-in, first-come first-served; small/primitive, best for smaller rigs. --Claude

name: Burnt Ranch Campground
note: USFS Shasta-Trinity NF campground on a bench above the Wild & Scenic Trinity River at Burnt Ranch, Hwy 299. ~16 sites with tables/fire rings, vault toilets, no hookups; drive-in, first-come first-served. --Claude

name: Hayden Flat Campground
note: USFS Shasta-Trinity NF campground on the Wild & Scenic Trinity River, Hwy 299 near Big Bar. Family loop (~35 sites, both sides of the highway) is first-come first-served; a separate group loop is reservable on recreation.gov. Tables/fire rings, vault toilets, no hookups; drive-in, hand-carry boat access. --Claude

name: Ackerman Campground
note: USFS Shasta-Trinity NF campground on the W shore of Lewiston Lake, above Lewiston Dam. ~51 sites with grass/gravel spurs, RVs/trailers to ~40 ft, tables/fire rings, no hookups; drive-in, open year-round (walk-in/FCFS; reservable May 21-Sep 10 on recreation.gov). --Claude

name: Denny Campground
note: Small primitive Shasta-Trinity NF campground on the New River (Trinity Alps), 5 sites, vault toilet, no drinking water, RVs/trailers to 25 ft, first-come, first-served. Reached via the long, narrow Denny Road off Hwy 299 (paved then gravel) - passable by a normal vehicle but slow. --Claude

name: Gray's Falls Campground
note: Six Rivers NF campground on the Trinity River along Hwy 299 north of Burnt Ranch, 33 sites, flush toilets and drinking water, first-come, first-served. Developed highway-access sites accommodate RVs (no posted length cap). --Claude

name: Clark Springs Campground
note: Shasta-Trinity NF campground on the west shore of Trinity Lake off Hwy 3, 20 sites, drinking water, vault toilets, RVs/trailers to 25 ft, first-come, first-served; trailhead for the Trinity Lakeshore Trail with a nearby public boat ramp. --Claude

name: Clear Creek Campground
note: Small Shasta-Trinity NF campground on Clear Creek west of Lakehead, 7 sites, vault toilet, no drinking water, RVs/trailers to ~22 ft (tight for larger rigs), first-come, first-served. --Claude

name: Jackass Spring Campground
note: Primitive Shasta-Trinity NF campground on the east shore of Trinity Lake, reached via the gravel East Side Road, 21 sites, vault toilet, no drinking water, RVs/trailers to 32 ft, first-come, first-served. --Claude

name: Trail Creek Campground
note: Klamath NF campground on Trail Creek off the paved Callahan-Cecilville Road south of Etna, 12 sites, drinking water, vault toilets, RVs/trailers to 45 ft, first-come, first-served. --Claude

name: Idlewild Campground
note: 11 sites on the North Fork Salmon River, Salmon/Scott River RD, Klamath NF, ~20 mi west of Etna on Sawyers Bar Rd; vault toilets, summer potable water, fire rings, max RV about 24 ft; first-come, first-served (not on recreation.gov), 14-day limit, open ~May-mid Oct. --Claude

name: Curly Jack Campground
note: On the Klamath Wild & Scenic River off Curly Jack Rd near Happy Camp, Happy Camp RD, Klamath NF; 16 single sites (most fit ~24 ft, some to 40 ft) plus 4 group sites, vault toilets, potable water, shaded paved loops; individual sites first-come, first-served (groups reservable on recreation.gov), open ~mid May-mid Oct. --Claude

name: Butte Meadows Campground
note: Along Butte Creek in the Butte Meadows community, Almanor RD, Lassen NF; 13 drive-in sites (paved Humboldt Rd access, road rough in spots), picnic tables, fire rings, vault toilets, self-pay; first-come, first-served (not on recreation.gov), open ~April-Oct. --Claude

name: Potato Patch Campground
note: On Highway 32 along Deer Creek, Almanor RD, Lassen NF; ~30-32 sites, drive-in off the paved highway, drinking water, vault toilets, fire rings, no hookups; first-come, first-served (not on recreation.gov), open ~April-Nov. --Claude

name: Lower Jones Valley Campground
note: Small Shasta-Trinity NF campground on the Pit River Arm of Shasta Lake; 11 sites (9 single, 2 double) with paved parking spurs, tent pads, bear boxes, vault toilets and potable water; back-in sites average ~30 ft. No hookups. First-come, first-served (pay via recreation.gov Scan & Pay app or on-site iron ranger); open year-round. --Claude

name: Honn Campground
note: Small primitive Lassen NF campground on Hat Creek along Hwy 89 (Hat Creek RD); 6 shady streamside sites with fire rings/BBQs and vault toilets, no potable water; flat drive-in access directly off the highway. First-come, first-served, open ~April-October. --Claude

name: Sims Flat Campground
note: Shasta-Trinity NF campground on the upper Sacramento River near Castella, just off I-5; 19 standard nonelectric sites, no hookups. First-come, first-served (pay via recreation.gov Scan & Pay). --Claude

name: Jackson Creek Campground
note: Tahoe NF (Sierraville RD) primitive campground on Jackson Creek below Jackson Meadows Reservoir. ~14 sites, vault toilets, no drinking water; drive-in via graded forest road (Henness Pass/Bowman Lake Rd), best for tents and smaller rigs. First-come, first-served - not on recreation.gov. ~5,650 ft. --Claude

name: Lakes Basin Campground
note: Plumas NF campground in the Lakes Basin Recreation Area near Gold Lake; 10 family sites plus a group site, vault toilets, drinking water; RVs to 42 ft on sites 2/18/20 (no RVs on sites 10/13/22 or the group site). About half FCFS, half reservable on Recreation.gov. --Claude

name: Lightning Tree Campground
note: Plumas NF campground on the east side of Lake Davis; ~40 standard nonelectric sites, tent and RV; most sites FCFS with the remainder reservable on Recreation.gov up to 6 months ahead. --Claude

name: Cherry Hill Campground
note: Lassen NF (Almanor RD) developed campground along Butte Creek near Jonesville at ~4,700 ft; 26 sites, vault toilets, no potable water, first-come, first-served. --Claude

name: Elam Campground
note: Lassen NF (Almanor RD) developed campground at the Deer Creek/Elam Creek confluence on Hwy 32 at ~4,400 ft; 15 sites (small to medium RVs), vault toilets, no potable water, first-come, first-served; Deer Creek trout fishing. --Claude

name: Soldier Meadows Campground
note: Lassen NF (Almanor RD) primitive developed campground in a meadow near Soldier Creek at ~4,890 ft, reached by forest roads; 15 sites, vault toilets, no potable water, first-come, first-served; open ~May-Oct. --Claude

name: Domingo Springs Campground
note: Lassen NF (Almanor RD) developed drive-in campground, 18 sites along the North Fork Feather River near the PCT; vault toilets, potable water, max 8 people per site; FCFS (fee paid on arrival), open ~May-Sep. --Claude
